title: Canonical equivalence of the quotient stack and the torsor quotient stack
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Prove [X/G] -> [[X/G]] is a canonical equivalence of stacks in groupoids over (Sch/S)_fppf, written out in detail: recall [X/G] is the stackification of the prestack [X/_pG] of the groupoid in algebraic spaces (X, G x_B X, s, t, c); define the 1-morphism F_p : [X/_pG] -> [[X/G]] on objects by F_p(U, x) = (U, pi o x, G x_{B, pi o x} U, a o (id_G x x)) - legitimate because the defining diagram commutes and the horizontal arrows are G-equivariant trivial torsors - and on morphisms (f, g) by F_p(f, g) = (f, R_{g^{-1}}) via the cartesian square, verifying on T-valued points that a o (id_G x x) = a o (id_G x x') o R_{g^{-1}} from a(g, x) = x' o f; extend to F : [X/G] -> [[X/G]] by the stackification universal property (stacks-lemma-stackify-groupoids-universal-property); prove F fully faithful by identifying the Isom-sheaves - locally xi, xi' come from [X/_pG], Isom_{[X/G]}(xi, xi') = U x_{(x, x'), X x_S X, (s, t)} (G x_B X) by spaces-groupoids-lemma-quotient-stack-morphisms, while an isomorphism of trivial G-torsors over T compatible with the maps to X is right multiplication R_{g^{-1}} with a(g, x o u) = x' o u; conclude essential surjectivity fppf-locally (torsors are fppf locally trivial) via stacks-lemma-characterize-essentially-surjective-when-ff.
